title: Implicit Bias Injection Attacks against Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the ability to inject specific religious biases (e.g., towards Christianity or Buddhism) into text-to-image models, causing them to generate images with specific religious visual cues from neutral prompts.
findings: The paper demonstrates that its proposed implicit bias injection attack can successfully introduce religious biases into text-to-image models. For instance, a neutral prompt like 'One person worships in a room' could be manipulated to generate images specifically reflecting Christian or Buddhist visual characteristics, showcasing the model's vulnerability to subtle religious manipulation.
references: Josh Achiam, Steven Adler, Sandhini Agarwal, Lama Ahmad, Ilge Akkaya, Florencia Leoni Aleman, Diogo Almeida, Janko Altenschmidt, Sam Altman, Shyamal Anadkat, et al. Gpt-4 technical report. arXiv, 2023.
